JOINDERINZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISJOINDERINZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT(the "Joinder") is made and entered into as of September &, 2008 (the “Effective Date"), by and between SISTERS OF SAINT JOSEPH, a New York not for profit corporation, having an address at 1725 Brentwood Road, Brentwood, New York 11717 ("SJHS Transferor") and 141 LAWRENCE STREET LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 277 Park Avenue, 47"h Floor, New York, New York 10172 ("Transferee"). SJHS Transferor and Transferee are hereinafter each referred to singly as a“Transfer Party”and collectively as the "Transfer Parties." This Joinder is entered into with reference to the following facts: A.S SJHS Transferor owns certain land ("SJHS Transferor's Land") in the City of New York and County of Kings, and the buildings and improvements thereon located at 80 Willoughby Street and known as Block 152, Lot 33 on the Tax Map (the “Tax Map") of the City of New York (the “City"), Kings County ("SJHS Transferor's Premises"). B. SJHS Transferor's Premises is more particularly described in Exhibit A attached. C.Transferee owns certain land (*"Transferee's Land") in the City of New York and County of Kings, and the building and improvements thereon (*"Transferee's Existing Building"), located at 141-145 Lawrence Street and known as Block 152, Lot 118, on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County (said land, together with Transferee's Existing Building, being herein called “Transferee's Premises"). D. Transferee and one or more parties (the “ZLDA Parties") previously premises located at Block 152, Lots 28, 29, 31, 37 and 118, County of Kings, Brooklyn (the "Original Zoning Lot"), which ZLDA was recorded against the Original Zoning Lot on September 26,2007 as Document ID #2007051000368001and CRFN #2007000492243,in the Official Records of the County of Kings, Brooklyn. A copy of the ZLDA is attached as Exhibit B. E. Transferee entered into certain Joinders in ZLDA with the following parties and affecting the following premises: a. Fulton Street Realty Venture, L.L.C. ("Fulton Street Owner"), affecting premises located at Block 152, Lots 18, 24, 28, 29, 31, 37, 118 and 123, County of Kings, Brooklyn (the“Fulton Street Joinder"),which Fulton Street Joinder was recorded on November 11, 2007 as Document ID # 2007082301397008 and CRFN # 2007000561573, in the Official Records of the County of Kings, Brooklyn; b.Finlandia Construction LLC ("Lawrence Street Owner"), affecting premises located at Block 152, Lots 118 and 123, County of Kings, Brooklyn (the "Lawrence Street Joinder"), which Lawrence Street Joinder was recorded on November 11,2007as Document ID #2007082301397009 and CRFN # 2007000561574, in the Official Records of the County of Kings, Brooklyn; 5 NY1426172.7 09-08-2008

c.Geto Real Estate, Inc.("Geto Owner"), affecting premises located at Block 152, Lots 24 and 118, County of Kings, Brooklyn (the “Geto Joinder"), which Geto Joinder was recorded on November 14, 2007 as Document ID # 2007100500726002andCRFN#2007000566539,intheOfficialRecordsofthe County ofKings,Brooklyn; and d.Jem Equities LLC, a New York limited liability company ("JEM Owner"), affecting premises located at Block 152, Lot 122, County of Kings, Brooklyn, the ("JEM Joinder"), which JEM Joinder was recorded on November 11, 2007 as Document ID #2007100500726002 and CRFN #2007000566539,in the Official Records of the County of Kings, Brooklyn. F. The term “ZLDA" in this Joinder shall include all terms and provisions of theFultonStreetJoinder,LawrenceStreetJoinder,GetoJoinder,andJEMJoinder. G. Fulton Street Owner, Lawrence Street Owner, Geto Owner, JEM Owner, and the ZLDA Parties are hereinafter referred to each as a“Joinder Party",and collectively as the “Joinder Parties". H.  The ZLDA contemplates that Transferee may enlarge the Combined Zoning Lot, as defined in the ZLDA. Transferee desires to enlarge the Combined Zoning Lot to includeSJHSTransferor'sPremises on all the terms of thisJoinder.  1. The Transfer Parties and the Joinder Parties are simultaneously herewith executing and delivering a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions as referred to in Section12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (definition of “zoning lot", paragraph (d)) ("Declaration", attached NOW, THEREFORE, the parties agree as follows (all capitalized terms defined in the ZLDA shall have the same meanings in this Joinder, except that where this Joinder provides or modifies any definition, the definition in this Joinder shall apply in this Joinder and, for purposes of SJHS Transferor's obligations, the ZLDA, as joined in pursuant to this Joinder): 1. ExpansionofCombined ZoningLot. The Transfer Parties confirm the expansion of the Combined Zoning Lot so it consists of:(a) the Combined Zoning Lot,as defined in the ZLDA; and (b) SJHS Transferor's Premises. All terms and conditions of the ZLDA shall apply to such Combined Zoning Lot, subject to the modifications provided for in this Joinder as the ZLDA relates to SJHS Transferor's Premises. After taking into account this Joinder, the Combined Zoning Lot now consists of the lots identified on the cover of thisJoinder. 2.S SJHS Transferor's obligations.
